title: iSpindel Upload Gap
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ispindel:reading
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sensor_id
| eval minutes_since=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)
| where minutes_since>30
| sort - minutes_since
description: Uses iSpindel fermentation telemetry telemetry to monitor time since each hydrometer last uploaded in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for fermentation batches flying blind due to missing uploads, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest iSpindel fermentation telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Sensor table of minutes since last reading.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights time since each hydrometer last uploaded so you can spot fermentation batches flying blind due to missing uploads before it becomes annoying.
